summary: Fixed both defects in M.list_extensions: readdir now filters dot-prefixed directories, and the invalid-manifest warning uses vim.notify_once for dedup. Added an isolated regression spec (3/3 passing). Verified headless: dot dir absent with no warning, malformed dir excluded with exactly one warning across two calls, valid extension unaffected.
decisions_made: Used vim.fn.readdir's predicate argument and vim.notify_once (stdlib), not hand-rolled filtering/dedup state

New regression spec placed at shared/extensions/manifest_spec.lua (new file) rather than the existing claude/extensions/manifest_spec.lua, to isolate temp-dir-only tests from the wrapper spec's live agent-system/extensions/ fixture
dead_ends: Memoizing/caching list_extensions() results to dedupe warnings — rejected: would stale manager.get_status()'s live update-available version check
